chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: Fletcher Henderson and Bessie Smith in Atlanta, 1922
summary: He first heard Fletcher Henderson's small group with Bessie Smith in Atlanta, around 1921-22.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Bessie, Mamie, Ma Rainey: the classic blues queens

blocks.x: Eighty-One and Ninety-One, almost next door, on the same side.
Do you remember of any attraction, the name of any band of people who used to come to the Eighty-One and Ninety-One?
At that time. One of the Smiths - was it Bessie Smith or Bessie Brown?
Was Bessie Smith through there, or Mamie Smith?
I remember when Fletcher Henderson came there. And Bessie Smith. Fletcher Henderson had about 4 pieces.
Did Ma Rainey ever show up there?
He had about 4 pieces in Atlanta. That's the first time I ever heard him play - Fletcher Henderson. ... Kaiser Marshall ... I don't know if he had a bass or not. I remember those three.
Bessie Smith was singing with him at that time?
Do you remember what year that was?
Were you in Morris Brown at that time?
I think it was around about 19 -
